race.comment: VESPER LYND (9) progressed nicely last time out to finish just 1.4 lengths from the winner in third over 1000m at Toowoomba. Finds a suitable race and can find the winner's circle. XERRI (3) was responsible for a solid effort last time out when second at Gatton over 1100m, beaten a long neck. Has a good record here at this journey with four wins and two minor placings from eight starts. Expected to go very well. MR WANDJI (5) was beaten 2.25 lengths into fifth in a 1200m contest at Esk at his latest appearance. The engagement of Samantha Pointon is a positive move. Finds a nice race and can atone. BOOGA RAY (8) is resuming from a spell of eight months and having her first run for the Kylie Nolan yard. Was in the placings when first-up from a spell last campaign at Gatton over 1100m. Fitter for a fourth in a recent trial over 925m at Toowoomba Inner Track and any push in betting must be respected.
